name: Acumatica
description_en:
Acumatica is a product in the ERP category. Its directory profile covers Warehouse Management, Supply Chain Management, Sales, Stock Management, HR Management, Financial Management, Asset Management, CRM.

Additional listed capabilities include Accounting Management, Dashboard, Project Management, Purchasing. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: coordinate stock locations and warehouse tasks; bring selected indicators and records into one view; coordinate project tasks, responsibilities and progress. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出会计管理、仪表盘、项目管理、采购。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：协调库存位置与仓库作业；在同一视图中汇集选定指标和记录；协调项目任务、负责人和进度。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
